_comment: Playlist sources with direct M3U/W3U feeds are listed under sources; a source may add "mirrors" and "mirror_templates" so the same file is reached from another address when its primary host is down. Optional url_env entries are skipped and explicitly reported until configured. reference_checks probe sites/repos that do not publish a static playlist; they are not imported as channels.

sources.note: TDTChannels (LaQuay/TDTChannels, 1.7k stars) - the long-running Spanish TDT catalogue of channels that broadcast openly on the internet, found in the iptv-org awesome-iptv Providers discussions (hunt of 2026-11-25). One stable list URL per format, national/regional/local channels, several feeds per channel (own CDN, GEO variants, OTTera ad-stitched) and #EXTVLCOPT Referer lines where a broadcaster needs them. Spain is already one of the better-covered countries (363 entries), so this is a quality source, not a volume one: the run report says how many of its feeds answer, and dead GEO variants are dropped by the same check as every other source.

priority_channels._comment: Used by scripts/channel_hunt.py. Each target is hunted for by name and tvg-id across the local corpus, the configured upstream indexes and (with --github-search) public M3U files on GitHub. Every candidate is verified end to end - HLS variant plus a real media segment - before it is written to the curated playlist. A target whose aliases are also matched by another target is not collected by the shorter one, so MeTV never picks up MeTV Toons links. The 'group' is the category scripts/categorize.py publishes the channel in; hunt targets use the curated category names so a freshly hunted link lands in the right group immediately.

targets.name: NFL Network
targets.note: The 24/7 league channel. It is categorised into Sports by scripts/categorize.py; up to six verified links are kept so the player always has a backup in 'Sports Backups'.

targets.name: NFL RedZone
targets.note: Sunday whip-around feed. Kept separate from the game-by-game event feeds; verified links land in Sports with backups.

priority_channels._blocklist_comment: URL fragments that must never be collected: feeds that are publicly listed under a channel they do not actually carry.

reference_checks.name: eja.tv
reference_checks.note: The site is checked for reachability only. No static M3U export was verified; it is not scraped/imported as channels. Configure EJA_M3U_URL only if you have an authorized direct playlist URL.

reference_checks.name: StepDaddyLiveHD
reference_checks.note: Repository tree is checked for static M3U files. The project describes a self-hosted proxy whose playlist is generated at an instance URL; configure STEPDADDYLIVEHD_PLAYLIST_URL to check a hosted instance.

reference_checks.name: dlive.sx
reference_checks.note: DaddyLiveHD 24/7 channel index. The page lists channels as HTML player pages (/stream/stream-<id>.php) whose stream address is resolved by JavaScript at run time, and its channels/schedule API needs a key issued by the operator, so the site publishes no static playlist. The catalogue is counted for visibility only and no channel is imported. Set DLIVE_M3U_URL to an authorized direct playlist URL - for example one generated by a self-hosted proxy - to import it and have every link checked like any other source.

reference_checks.name: xyzstreams
reference_checks.note: Live-event index (soccer, NFL, NBA and more) whose schedules the site renders in the viewer's own time zone and whose streams are resolved by JavaScript inside its player pages, so it publishes no static playlist. Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels; its backup index is https://xyzstreams.space/alt.html. Configure XYZSTREAMS_M3U_URL only if you have an authorized direct playlist.

reference_checks.name: ppv.st
reference_checks.note: Live-event directory (NFL, college football, basketball, soccer, PPV cards) that lists its fixtures and countdowns but serves no static M3U; the page itself now points readers to https://mirrors.st/ for its current address. Checked for reachability only, never imported. Configure PPVST_M3U_URL only if you have an authorized direct playlist.

reference_checks.name: Easy-Web-TV-M3u8
reference_checks.note: zhangboheng's all-in-one web TV catalogue. Its country pages are generated in the browser from the iptv-org public API (which this repository already reads through the iptv-org source), and the repository tree publishes no .m3u file at all, so there is nothing to import. This check counts the playlists it carries so a future static export is noticed.

reference_checks.name: iptvcat
reference_checks.note: IPTV Cat's US catalogue (1,621 channels, 1,593 online on 2026-11-24; 14,018 worldwide). Each row offers only a single-channel wrapper playlist (list.iptvcat.net/my_list/s/<hash>.m3u8 around the real stream URL) and the bulk 'Download this list' action is built in the browser from a session list, so the site publishes no single static M3U the scraper can fetch and link-check as a source. Sampled wrapper URLs (e.g. the 30A TV feeds) are already in the published corpus, and the catalogue is smaller than the current lineup in both the US (1,621 vs ~2,900) and worldwide (14,018 vs 19,621). Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels; see docs/SOURCE-HUNT-2026-11-24.md. If IPTV Cat ever publishes a static bulk M3U, add it as a source and let the daily link check decide what survives.

reference_checks.name: gradetv
reference_checks.note: Grade TV (iptv-org Providers discussion #769) is a browser catalogue and M3U exporter over the iptv-org channel data - its ids are iptv-org ids such as 00sReplay.us and 3ABNEnglish.us - so it duplicates the iptv-org source already configured. Checked for reachability only and never imported.

reference_checks.name: broadcast-atlas
reference_checks.note: Broadcast Atlas (iptv-org Providers discussion #845) is a directory and player built on iptv-org's channel data, with each channel keeping its iptv-org identifier; it publishes no playlist of its own, so importing it would only re-fetch the iptv-org source. Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels.

reference_checks.name: open-tv-atlas
reference_checks.note: Open TV Atlas (iptv-org Providers discussion #968) generates M3U URLs by combining iptv-org language, category and quality slices, so every link it can produce already arrives through the configured iptv-org source. Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels.

reference_checks.name: pflix
reference_checks.note: PFlix live catalogue, checked 2026-11-25: 58 Sports, 61 News, 200 Entertainment, 110 Movies & Series, 38 Kids, 22 Music, 24 Documentary and 32 Lifestyle channels, all played by its own Cloudflare-protected web player. It publishes no static M3U and no public channel API, its cards resolve streams inside the page, and it carries no BBC America (BBC News and BBC Earth are present), so there is nothing this repository can import from it. Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels.

discovery._comment: Used by scripts/discover.py on the monthly schedule. Candidates are fetched, measured against the published playlist, and sample-checked. Anything that clears the thresholds is written to playlists/discovery/approved-sources.json and merged into the next regular scrape. Nothing is published without the daily link check.

candidates.name: Fanmingming-Live
candidates.note: Large daily-updated public live-TV list. The best TV M3U in the repository tree is selected each month.

candidates.name: Akiraleal-IPTV
candidates.note: Public IPTV playlist repository; the largest static M3U in the tree is selected automatically.

candidates.name: TianmuTNT-IPTV
candidates.note: Public IPTV playlist repository, refreshed frequently.

candidates.name: matthuisman-mjh
candidates.note: matthuisman's generated NZ/AU playlist (Sky NZ, Three, Bravo, Whakaata Maori, Warner Bros FAST channels and more, served through the i.mjh.nz/.r/ redirector with an Apple TV user-agent). The published lineup is thin on Oceania (2 primary + 1 backup entry) and Australia (15 primary + 1 backup; the country playlist carries 32), and only 4 mjh- ids are in the corpus today, so this is the one new source from the 2026-11-24 hunt that could add genuinely new channels. The discovery engine sample-checks it before anything is promoted; the .r/ redirector may need the published user-agent, which the sample check will show. The PlutoTV/SamsungTVPlus/Plex folders on the same host are XMLTV guides only (no playlists) - see the epg_sources block.

candidates.name: YanG-Gather
candidates.note: The one importable upstream behind HerbertHe/iptv-sources (a generator, not a playlist - see docs/SOURCE-HUNT-2026-11-24.md). Gather.m3u (123 links) is China Mobile Migu sports, movie-rotation and esports livestream proxies (Bilibili/Huya/Douyu via cdn.ttvb.eu.org), not general TV; all 123 URLs are new to the corpus, so the monthly engine will sample-check them and promote only if they actually answer. HerbertHe's other upstreams were rejected with evidence: YueChan is rtp:// multicast, Beijing-IPTV is 192.168.x.x LAN addresses, joevess is an empty file, cymz6's repository is gone (404), and fanmingming/iptv-org are already covered.

candidates.name: ZeroStreams
candidates.note: felixiptv/streams (ZeroStreams) publishes validated live HLS feeds with clean event titles and alternate feeds. Measured on 2026-11-27: 51 entries and 51 URLs, all 51 new to this corpus, mostly motorsport, baseball and basketball events. Its status.json was last written 2026-10-19, so the repository's refresh claim is not proven by that file; the monthly discovery engine's sample check is what decides, and nothing is promoted unless it answers.

epg_sources._comment: Upstream XMLTV guides merged into the repository's own guides, one family per published country. scripts/epg_sources.py expands the per_country templates with every published country code ({cc} = lowercase, {CC} = uppercase) and always includes the fixed feeds first. These URLs are verified by scripts/epg_check.py and harvested by scripts/epg_build.py, but never advertised in playlist x-tvg-url headers: the merged guide already carries their listings. Disable one family with enabled=false; disable the whole block with enabled=false at the top.
